events.description: Helen says Nina Bookbinder is here to see Chandler Bing.
Chandler Bing says Helen should send Nina Bookbinder in.
Chandler Bing says Nina Bookbinder should come in.
Nina Bookbinder says Chandler Bing wanted to see Nina Bookbinder.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing has just been going over Nina Bookbinder's data.

Nina Bookbinder says post-dating Nina Bookbinder's Friday numbers is bad.
